name: Saeki Jun
source:
One of the hero's classmates A so-called cyber geek who is familiar with personal computers, mobile phones, mobile phones, and navigation systems. Her room is especially noisy for computers, and she will not let go of her laptop during the lessons. She is friendly and has a frank attitude towards everyone.

[from Getchu]
